Dear Hiring Team,

I am excited to apply for the Organic Growth Analyst position. As a junior digital marketer with hands-on experience in SEO, content strategy, and analytics, I am eager to contribute to your data-driven organic growth initiatives for B2B software clients.

In my current role at Episto, I manage on-page SEO, write keyword-targeted content, and build WordPress sites, using tools like SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics, and Search Console to track performance. My personal project, mirook.com, showcases my ability to implement technical SEO and GEO strategies, including structured data and entity optimization, to improve visibility across traditional and AI-powered search engines.

I am analytical, detail-oriented, and comfortable working independently in a remote environment. I am also available to overlap with Eastern Time hours. I am eager to deepen my expertise in SEO and analytics and grow into a strategist role.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how I can add value to your team.

Best regards,

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my strong interest in the Organic Growth Analyst position. With a solid foundation in SEO, content marketing, and analytics, and a passion for data-driven growth, I am confident that I can contribute effectively to your B2B software clients' success.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I have gained practical experience in executing SEO strategies end-to-end. I conduct keyword research, write keyword-targeted blog content, and manage on-page optimization for client websites. I also build and maintain WordPress sites using Elementor and Astra, ensuring technical excellence. My daily use of SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics, and Google Search Console has honed my ability to analyze performance data and derive actionable insights.

Beyond my professional experience, I have developed mirook.com, a project where I implemented advanced SEO and GEO techniques. I designed the site, integrated structured data (JSON-LD), and performed iterative technical audits to improve visibility across both traditional and AI-driven search engines. This project demonstrates my proactive learning and ability to apply cutting-edge strategies.

I am particularly drawn to this role because of the opportunity to work with experienced strategists and grow into a senior position. I am eager to deepen my expertise in analytics, content strategy, and conversion optimization. My strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and collaborative mindset align well with your requirements. I am comfortable working independently in a remote environment and can overlap with Eastern Time hours.

I am excited about the prospect of contributing to your team and helping clients achieve measurable growth. Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can add value.

Sincerely,
